source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 22 May 1958, p. 2 ("Newtownards Borough Council: Glen Ward councillorships")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: names and votes read on the page image of the Belfast News-Letter, 22 May 1958, p. 2 (NEWTOWNARDS, Glen Ward): Georgina Fowlis 449, H. Martin 498, W. M'Gimpsey 401; not elected H. Cavan (no vote).

note: Election of the aldermen and councillors of Newtownards Borough Council on 21 May 1958, reported ward by ward. Each of the four wards returned one alderman; Castle, Victoria and Glen also elected three councillors, while Scrabo's three councillors were unopposed. H. Cavan was also nominated and not elected; no vote is printed for him, so he is recorded without one. Losers not printed: re-checked on the British Newspaper Archive's page image of the Belfast News-Letter, 22 May 1958, p. 2 (13 Nov 2026): H. Cavan is named as not elected, without a vote.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of Belfast News-Letter, 22 May 1958, p. 2 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the defeated H. Cavan, named without a vote, was added; the paper prints 'Fowlis' (kept in Name_As_Printed), but her name is recorded as Georgina Foulis, the form of her other returns (1952-67).
